posts.subject: Administrator Applying.
posts.bodyHtml:
My name is Sondre Larsen (Sundre -A-). I am a 16 year old gamer from Norway. I have to write in english because I don't know German.
The reason that I want to become an administrator, is because I want to help improve the server in any way I can. Since I have been playing there, I know that there is several people that are not kind or following the rules.
I have played on the server for a really long time, and I absolutely love everything about it! My hobbies are to play competitive, surf and playing knife game on your server. IF I became an administrator I would use my "powers" with responsibility and try to improve the server. I will NEVER use them in any wrong way. I have experience with being an administrator, and that is why I want to become administrator on your knife server. I play on the server several hours EVERY day, unless I am on vacation.
If I ever saw someone insulting another person, I would try to ask him why he is doing it, and try to make him stop. If he continues to talk shit about others, I would ask the others to mute him, or if he went too far, kick him. Nobody should be insulting others, no matter what, because you never know the backstory of anyone. My strengths is that I can make people calm down, and I consider myself as a [funny] person. I know how to behave myself. I don't think I have any weakness. The only weakness I might have is when people talk about cancer as a [funny] thing, I would get depressed because a friend of mine died from it five years ago. But exept from that, there is nothing.
[dream*]   [like*] 
HAVE A GREAT DAY megusta* 
-Sondre

Hello Sundre,
I'm sorry but in my opinion Dream doesnt need any Admins from another country, most of the posts in the forum and all Admins are german.
Since i know all of the Admins can speak good to fluent english it isnt that hard to communicate with players from others countrys.
Your application isnt the best either, you get a no from me.
I wish you good luck and fun on the servers tho, have a great day.
Greetings - CHRiTiXzZ

Hey Sundre,
You know that you need to be german to apply as an administrator but you still try it! Thats nice and you show me with this that you really want the position. If you have enough english skills you have a chance in our team. I think on the Knife Server we dont need 100% German Admins because they are playing much players from Norway, etc. And if germans are beefing or something you cant do something. Thats the problem but i think you can contact a german admin when something like that will happen. (By the way my english is not so good xD) And Im Sorry for your friend, i think we all understand it and cancer is nothing to joke about.. But the people still joking about.


Finally you get from me a Yes.


I hope you get the position [;)] Good Luck 🙂


-Gimme | Nico
You will get a yes from me too^^

Hey Sundre,


First off all I want to remark that I appreciate your effort to support our administrative team.
Still I am sorry to tell you that your application is hereby rejected.
Your application itself is kind of short and not very comprehensive - I do know that you can not understand the example but still you could have wrote a little more and structured it in a more clear way.
Secondly the fact that you are not speaking german is impractical. Since our community is a german community and our servers are mostly visited by german people you will only be able to take action in a small part of the conflicts and even less in the forum. Additionally since you are not a native speaker your style and understanding of language do not differ crucial from the one of our german team members.


All in all you simply would not be as effective as another bilingual applicant.


I hope that you got the point I was trying to make.
We would appreciate it if you continued playing on our servers.


Sincerely


BlackFire
